bio.text: Teresa Martinez is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 16; she assumed office on January 9, 2023.
She previously worked as director of coalitions and Hispanic outreach for U.S. Rep. Paul Gosar and, before that, as political director of the Arizona Republican Party.
She advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
